senses.sense_definition: A brief summary of the main points of a discussion, narrative, or document.

examples.text: The professor provided a quick <w>recapitulation</w> of the lecture's main arguments before the exam.
This report serves as a <w>recapitulation</w> of the project's progress and future goals.

senses.sense_definition: The section of a musical movement in sonata form where the initial themes are restated.

examples.text: The orchestra played the <w>recapitulation</w> with great intensity, bringing the symphony to a powerful close.
Listen for the return of the main theme during the <w>recapitulation</w> of the first movement.

senses.sense_definition: The theory that the development of an individual organism repeats the evolutionary history of its species.

examples.text: The concept of <w>recapitulation</w> was once a central, though now largely debated, idea in developmental biology.
Early scientists often used the theory of <w>recapitulation</w> to explain the similarities between different animal embryos.

senses.sense_definition: A theological doctrine regarding the summation and fulfillment of human history and divine purpose in Jesus Christ.

examples.text: The early church fathers frequently discussed the <w>recapitulation</w> of all things in Christ.
This theological work explores the <w>recapitulation</w> of human experience through the life of Jesus.
